body.statement: Every returned certificate \(\kappa_H\) is sound over \(\Theta_H\). On a formula branch, the registry contains every context normalizer, reachable fixing margin, and reduced rational-elimination denominator together with its positivity-ledger factorization; \(O_H(\Theta_H)\subseteq\mathfrak D_H\), and \(F_H\{O_H(\theta)\}=T_{a,H}(\theta)\) for every \(\theta\in\Theta_H\). No value is asserted outside \(\mathfrak D_H\). On a negative branch, for every \(b\in\mathcal B_H\), \(\theta_b^{+},\theta_b^{-}\in\Theta_H\), \(O_H(\theta_b^{+})=O_H(\theta_b^{-})\), and \(T_{a,H}(\theta_b^{+})\ne T_{a,H}(\theta_b^{-})\); both laws have selector support exactly \(H\) and strictly positive structurally admissible cells.
body.justification: A failed search becomes an exact, auditable nonidentification result instead of an inconclusive token.
body.gap: The 2024 anchor proves witnesses for specified failures but does not furnish a fixed-support global pair on every residual branch or an open family of legal pairs.
body.consumer: A provenance-aware do-search backend can return machine-checkable formulas or legal missing-context and twin diagnostics.
body.proof_tex:
Let a certificate be returned.  By \(\textnormal{def:sa-csid-machine}\), every admitted transition has passed its finite eligibility test and exact local polynomial obligations.  Start with the normalized relation supplied by \(\textnormal{thm:normalization-equivalence}\).  Induct over the finite transition log.  A selector step replaces a gate occurrence by an equal zero-one polynomial modulo the inherited constraints.  A fixing step replaces a kernel by \(K_{s,D}/m_{s,W}\); after multiplication by the registered denominator, the verifier's polynomial identity says that the old and new represented kernels agree.  A sum or district step has the same property by its cross-multiplied identity.  Thus the represented observation-target relation is invariant on the domain on which all registered denominators are positive.

On a formula branch, the residual verifier has accepted \(F_H=P/D\) only after establishing
\[
D\,t_{a,H}^N-P(o_H^N)=0\pmod{\mathcal J}. \tag{4}
\]
For \(\theta\in\Theta_H\), put \(\eta=\nu_H(\theta)\).  Then \(\eta\in\mathcal I_H\), so every polynomial in \(\mathcal J\) vanishes at \(\eta\).  Every selector normalizer is positive at \(O_H(\theta)\), every fixing margin is positive by its sum-product ledger certificate, and every reduced elimination denominator is positive by its required factorization.  This is exactly \(\textnormal{lem:restricted-support-denominator-positivity}\), and it proves
\[
O_H(\Theta_H)\subseteq\mathfrak D_H. \tag{5}
\]
Evaluating (4), dividing by the positive value of \(D\), and transporting through normalization yields
\[
F_H\{O_H(\theta)\}
=F_H\{O_H^N(\eta)\}
=T_{a,H}^N(\eta)
=T_{a,H}(\theta).
\]
Because \(F_H\) was defined only on \(\mathfrak D_H\), this proves no assertion outside that domain.

On a negative branch, the exact verifier supplies rational affine maps \(b\mapsto\eta_b^+\) and \(b\mapsto\eta_b^-\).  Its simplex and gate checks give \(\eta_b^\pm\in\mathcal I_H\) for every \(b\in\mathcal B_H\); in particular, the selector-mass signs are positive exactly on \(H\), zero off \(H\), and all admissible observation polynomials are strictly positive.  The accepted polynomial identities and constant-sign inequality give
\[
O_H^N(\eta_b^+)=O_H^N(\eta_b^-),
\qquad
T_{a,H}^N(\eta_b^+)\ne T_{a,H}^N(\eta_b^-). \tag{6}
\]
Define \(\theta_b^\pm=\rho_H(\eta_b^\pm)\).  Normalization equivalence implies \(\theta_b^\pm\in\Theta_H\) and transports (6) to
\[
O_H(\theta_b^+)=O_H(\theta_b^-),
\qquad
T_{a,H}(\theta_b^+)\ne T_{a,H}(\theta_b^-).
\]
Membership in \(\Theta_H\) supplies exact selector support and strict admissible-cell positivity.  These are precisely the two advertised soundness alternatives.
